# A single-message thread keeps its sort boundary flag after losing its twisty

The original hidden-child deletion change cleared ISTHREAD with Elided and HASCHILDREN. The fixed accepted source preserves ISTHREAD and clears only the latter two bits when at most one child remains. IsContainer reads HASCHILDREN, while ReverseThreads copies groups at ISTHREAD boundaries. Presentation and sort grouping therefore use distinct flag roles in this path. This is static source evidence; it does not reproduce the historical sort failure or audit the later fix as a separate entry.

Scope: Threaded DB view hidden-child deletion and sort boundaries.
